params.body:
The invite, the password reset, the curation proposals and the `/curate` page still wore the look from before the September redesign: an orange eyebrow and an orange round pill button. The design system has one real button, a green block with white text and square corners ("the round pill of the previous site is gone"), and gentells.com's own mails already use it.

`packages/server/mail-style.mjs` holds the site's mail theme values (ink, body, muted, line, ground, green, coral), the wordmark image, one `mailButton`, one `mailLink` and one `mailLayout`: the ground, the wordmark, and a white card with a hairline and square corners. All four places use it now:
- **Invite and reset:** a heading, text, the green button. The reset's "if it was not you" moves under the button, in the caption colour.
- **Proposals:** each proposal separated by a hairline instead of a boxed card; Approve is the green button, Skip is plain text; the erroring-sources line is in coral, the one thing that asks for attention.
- **`/curate` page:** the same colours and button.

No orange (`#E8400C`), no pill (`999px`) and no old teal (`#0FA3B1`) is left in the server.

The wordmark is the PNG gentells.com's mails load; that file lands with the gentells-site PR "The mail wordmark exists". Until then the alt text "Gentells" shows.

954 tests pass.
params.title: Mails in the house style: the green square button, the wordmark, no orange pill
